instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: SaaS Metrics Pro develops B2B analytics software that helps mid-sized companies optimize resource allocation and predict future operational bottlenecks. The company operates in a relatively mature digital space with minimal direct regulatory hurdles.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company recently implemented an Agile methodology for feature development, which significantly reduced time-to-market by 20%. They also launched a successful upsell strategy targeting enterprise clients.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary goal is aggressive user acquisition and market share expansion in the SMB analytics space over the next three years. We aim to increase recurring revenue by 150%.
answers.teamSize: The team consists of 12 highly skilled engineers and product managers, fostering a collaborative and results-driven culture.
answers.additionalContext: The market is becoming saturated with similar tools, requiring a focus on niche differentiation and rapid scaling.

opportunities.title: Tiered Subscription Model Implementation
opportunities.rationale: Moving from a flat subscription to a tiered model allows us to capture different customer segments (SMB vs. Mid-Market) and increase Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) without requiring massive infrastructure changes.

first_actions: Define three distinct pricing tiers based on feature depth and usage limits.
Develop marketing collateral explaining the value proposition of each tier.
milestones: Pilot tier launch and feedback loop established (Month 4).

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Predictive Bottleneck Engine
opportunities.rationale: Integrating a proprietary machine learning model to provide predictive maintenance and bottleneck alerts will differentiate us significantly from competitors who rely on simple descriptive analytics, enabling premium pricing.

first_actions: Allocate dedicated R&D team for ML model training pipeline setup.
Identify key data sources required for the new predictive algorithm.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce customer churn by 8% through enhanced predictive features.
milestones: MVP of the prediction engine built (Month 9).
Beta testing with top 10 growth customers (Month 12).

opportunities.title: Strategic Partnerships with Industry Vertical Leaders
opportunities.rationale: Forming exclusive integration partnerships with industry-specific software (e.g., CRM or ERP providers) will immediately open up new, high-value distribution channels and validate our platform's ecosystem fit.

first_actions: Identify five potential strategic partnership targets.
Draft detailed integration proposal outlining mutual benefit.
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 3 new high-volume distribution partners within the fiscal year.

next_steps.action: Conduct a feasibility study for the AI-Powered Predictive Engine (Opportunity 2).
Establish and pilot the new Tiered Subscription Model (Opportunity 1).
Identify three strategic industry verticals for partnership exploration.

key_weaknesses: High reliance on key technical personnel (talent bottleneck).
Slow feature velocity due to internal process friction during rapid growth phases.
Inconsistent adoption rates across different customer segments.
